# Facilitator HTTP API

x402 facilitator for the Obyte network (schemes exact and batch-settlement). Non-custodial: it never holds funds. /verify is read-only; /settle broadcasts (exact) or commits a voucher via the seller watcher (batch-settlement) and is idempotent.

Machine-readable: [`openapi.json`](/openapi.json) (also served by the facilitator at `GET /openapi.json`).
The seller watcher connects over a WebSocket at `/watcher` (signed login; see the payment channels guide).

## `POST /verify`

Check a payment without moving funds

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` when `FACILITATOR_API_KEYS` is set; rate-limited.

Body: `{ x402Version, paymentPayload, paymentRequirements }` (x402).

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Verification result (also for an invalid payment) |
| 400 | invalid_json / missing_parameters |
| 401 | Missing or wrong API key (when FACILITATOR_API_KEYS is set) |
| 413 | Body larger than BODY_LIMIT_BYTES |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded (RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE) |

## `POST /settle`

Settle a verified payment (idempotent; repeat the same request while pending)

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` when `FACILITATOR_API_KEYS` is set; rate-limited.

Body: `{ x402Version, paymentPayload, paymentRequirements }` (x402).

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Settlement result; errorReason settlement_pending means "retry later" |
| 400 | invalid_json / missing_parameters |
| 401 | Missing or wrong API key (when FACILITATOR_API_KEYS is set) |
| 413 | Body larger than BODY_LIMIT_BYTES |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded (RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE) |

## `GET /discovery/resources`

Bazaar: list cataloged paid resources

| Query parameter | Type | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | no |  |
| `payTo` | string | no |  |
| `scheme` | string | no |  |
| `network` | string | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no | `20` |
| `offset` | integer | no | `0` |

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | One page of resources |
| 404 | Discovery is disabled |

## `GET /discovery/search`

Bazaar: search cataloged resources (all words must match)

| `type` | string | no |  |
| `payTo` | string | no |  |
| `scheme` | string | no |  |
| `network` | string | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no | `20` |
| `cursor` | string | no |  |

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Matching resources |
| 400 | query is required |
| 404 | Discovery is disabled |
